user: close all my tabs except this one

args.summary:
I don't have a tab-management tool — I can navigate or open tabs, but I can't see or close your other tabs from here.

The fastest built-in way to do exactly what you want:
1. Right-click this "New Tab" tab at the top of the browser.
2. Choose "Close other tabs" (Chrome/Edge) — everything except this tab closes instantly.

Alternatives: hold Ctrl+W (Cmd+W on Mac) to close tabs one by one, or right-click a tab and pick "Close tabs to the right" if you only want to clear one side.
